title: SDK Adapter Interface Design Review
purpose: Design the standalone codex-sdk-orchestrator-tool adapter/plugin interface without creating a package, changing runner behavior, or moving AE Agent project-local governance checks.

rationale: M171 closed the extraction block with adapter/plugin interface design as the next standalone-packaging blocker.

The reusable write-runner core already exists, but package-independent execution still needs a stable way to inject project policy, evidence validators, package assertions, README assertions, and handoff rules.
A design artifact can reduce ambiguity before a future standalone package milestone while staying inside the no-approval local-only runway.
Implementation, package creation, SDKThread/network proof, CEP-panel writes, dependency changes, and push remain out of scope.

standaloneAdapterInterface.loadModel: A standalone tool loads one project adapter module or JSON-compatible config, validates it locally, then passes its policy and project-check hooks into the neutral orchestrator core.
neutralCoreBoundary: path normalization and forbidden path matching
thread option construction from injected safety contract
operation envelope loading and mode validation
runtime store selection and failure diagnostic serialization
post-run diff and planned-path contract checks
projectAdapterBoundary: project scope names and path allowlists
which sdk-write lanes are enabled or review-required
project evidence packet schemas and committed artifact paths
package script names and command assertions
README milestone snippets and documentation assertions
local smoke catalog and live/external/mutating approval gates

mustRemainProjectLocalUntilImplementatio: blocked-work policy for SDKThread/network, CEP-panel writes, live CEP/AE, external-provider/OpenAI CLI planner, mutating-live validation, dependency changes, push, PR, and cleanup

minimumPackagePieces: adapter loader and adapter self-check command
neutral core imports from orchestrator/core or copied package sources
project adapter fixture for AE Agent
local contract smoke proving project hooks remain injected and fail closed
documentation that separates generic tool behavior from project adapter policy
implementationOrder: create adapter interface fixture without moving current runner entrypoints
build adapter self-check smoke around the fixture
introduce standalone package/workspace only after the fixture contract is stable
wire AE Agent scripts to call the standalone package through the adapter only in a later behavior-preserving milestone
blockedUntilSeparateGoal: moving buffered acceptance checks out of AE Agent

standalonePackagingBlockers.neededBeforePackaging: Create a separate package/workspace plan for codex-sdk-orchestrator-tool with its own tests and release boundary.
Use this M172 interface design to build a real adapter loader, adapter fixture, and self-check in a separate implementation milestone.
Review orchestrator/codex-sdk-orchestrator.mjs separately if a standalone read-only CLI is still desired.
Keep AE Agent local checks here until a real adapter hook implementation proves equivalent fail-closed behavior.
Do not run SDKThread/network, CEP-panel SDK writes, live CEP/AE, external-provider validation, mutating-live validation, package installs, or push without separate explicit approval.

nextRecommendedState.title: Standalone integration notes or adapter self-check fixture
nextRecommendedState.recommendedAction: Continue only with a small local-only documentation or fixture milestone that does not create a standalone package, change dependencies, run SDKThread/network, or move AE Agent project-local acceptance checks.
